system.creatureSubtype: immune to Charmed; Fortune on saves vs magic; does not need air, food, drink, or sleep
system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Perfect Sight 30 ft, Telepathy 120 ft
system.tactics: Mindflayers do not fight, they process problems. Mind Blast disrupts enemy formations while the Mindflayer positions for tentacle Grapples on isolated priority targets. They will protect themselves first and the summoner second and will telepathically communicate their assessment of the tactical situation whether asked or not. A Cooperative Mindflayer is a terrifying asset. A Friendly one is as close to a genuine partner as an Aberration gets, though it is curious about everything in an unsettling way.
system.attacksNotes:
Tentacles [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 5), Reach: 5 ft

  • Margin 1:: 10 damage (6 + 4 Str) + 4 psychic damage (Ignore DR); target makes Fortitude [Easy] save or Grappled.
  • Margin 2: 10 damage, DR halved (round up) + 8 psychic damage; Grappled (no save).
  • Margin 3: 10 damage, DR halved (round up) + 8 psychic damage; Grappled and target's Intelligence reduced by 2 until end of encounter.

Extract Brain (Grappled targets only) [Combat]: Against one Grappled creature. Target makes Fortitude [Hard] save. 0 Successes: Instantly killed. 1 success: 10 damage and Stunned for 1 minute.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes:
Mind Blast (Recharge 5-8) [Combat]: The Mindflayer emits psychic energy in a 60-foot cone. All creatures in the area make Will saves. Compare Int 8 + Arcane 7 targeting to each target's save successes.

  • Margin 1:: 16 psychic damage + Dazed.
  • Margin 2: 16 psychic damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned for 1 minute (Will [Easy] save each turn ends).

Telepathy 120 ft: Communicates telepathically with any creature within range that has a language. It uses this to understand precisely what is being asked of it. Mind Shield: Fortune on Will saves.
